title: Check editor export in real CapCut, Premiere Pro, Resolve and Final Cut
description: The timeline files (Premiere, Resolve, Final Cut) and CapCut-ready clip packs from #19/#21/#23 have only been checked against tests and stand-ins. Open real exports in each editor, confirm cuts, captions and media relink, and fix what breaks. See export-to-editors design doc.

title: Redesign the Outputs page: one card per run, grouped by step, with filters
description: Outputs page today lists files flat. Redesign it to show one card per run, with that run's files grouped by the step that made them, plus filters (automation, step type, date, status). Ships with Convex and screen tests.

title: mastra-chat-kit: duplicate date-note cache bug
description: Bug in the separate mastra-chat-kit repo: the date note is duplicated through the cache. Chowderr is fixing it in mastra-chat-kit; tracked here because the ncat-dash agent chat depends on it.

title: Editor gap: wait for both branches before continuing
description: A step after an If (or parallel branches) should be able to wait until every incoming branch has finished before it runs, instead of running once per branch. Needs a join rule in automation-core, the runner, the canvas and the agent's schema. Ships with tests.

title: @Agent mention answers: notification bell and email
description: When someone tags @Agent in a review comment (PR #30), the answer only appears in the thread. Add a bell notification and an email (toSend) to the person who asked when the answer lands. Respect notification settings once those exist.

title: Agent settings: model picker, house rules, default platforms
description: Team-level settings for the agent: house rules it always follows (tone, brand do's and don'ts), default platforms so it does not have to ask every time, and later a model picker routed through Vercel AI Gateway. Ships with tests.

title: Notification settings
description: A settings section where each person chooses which events notify them (failed runs, approvals waiting, review comments, @Agent answers) and how (in-app bell, email via toSend). Today alerts go to the whole team with no way to tune them. Ships with tests.

title: Test the editor export: Convex functions and screens
description: Automated tests for export to video editors (#19, #21, #23): convex/exports.test.ts (12), editor-export screen tests (13), editors-card screen tests (6). Tests only. Stacked on #25, which is now merged, so it needs retargeting to main and merging. Not covered: a Playwright test for the export, which needs the toolkit stand-in to answer the Clips step's two stages. PR https://github.com/hamchowderr/ncat-dash/pull/27.

title: Agent asks which platforms, builds, then tries the automation on a real upload
description: The agent asks what only the person can decide (platforms as a pick-several question, the trigger if not given, settings a step marks 'ask') before building, builds one clips branch per platform, then tries the working copy on a real upload via automations.tryOnUpload and checks the run (list_uploads, try_automation, check_run tools). Re-recorded real-model conversation. Tests: Convex agentTry, agent unit tests, screens, registry, recorded-model. In draft PR https://github.com/hamchowderr/ncat-dash/pull/36.

title: A way for when a step fails
description: Editor gap: a step that does work (catalog step, Clips, Export) gets a second way out used only when it fails. After retries run out, the failing step hands its input files to whatever hangs off its red dashed 'Fails' handle and the run carries on; a run whose failures were all handled ends done without alerting. Step panel gets an 'If it fails' row; export/import keep the failure way; agent add/connect take branch 'failed' (and 'yes'/'no' for If). Tests: automation-core, Convex, screens. In draft PR https://github.com/hamchowderr/ncat-dash/pull/38.

title: Phase 3: automations on a canvas, with triggers, approvals and a job limit
description:
* Phase 3: automations on a canvas, with triggers, approvals and a job limit

Adds automations: chains of catalog steps drawn on a React Flow canvas and run
by a table-driven runner in Convex. Each run keeps its own copy of the steps and
every step's state updates live.

- Triggers: run now, webhook address, schedule (interval or daily in a time
  zone, checked every minute), and new upload.
- A one-file step runs once per incoming file; list steps take them all.
- Approval steps hold a run until a team member approves or rejects.
- Per-team limit on jobs sent to the toolkit at once, set on /settings.
- packages/automation-core holds the graph, placeholder and schedule rules,
  with tests.

* Keep the automation editor's three panes inside their frame

title: FFmpeg recipes: 22 ready-made compose jobs as steps
description:

palette. Blanks that end up in a filter graph are limited to safe values
and text is escaped for all three of FFmpeg's readings.

Tests run every recipe through a real FFmpeg, built the way the toolkit
builds its command, and compare drawn text pixel for pixel with FFmpeg's
own unescaped rendering. CI installs FFmpeg for this.

title: Run the agent on a real model and record it
description:
The first runs with a real model (Anthropic, Sonnet 5.5) found four problems that the
stand-in model could not:

- Each step of a run added another date message to the prompt and a cache breakpoint
  with it, so Anthropic refused the fourth step (it allows four). The turn context now
  replaces the one the step before added (chat kit code, turn-context.ts).
- Asking for a step's settings (list_step_types with a type) failed for every step whose
  settings carry "$schema", which Convex cannot send. Keys starting with "$" are dropped.
- The step list names triggers "trigger:upload", and the model sent that as the kind the
  dashboard wants as "upload". The change tool now takes either.
- The model put its first step "after": "trigger". That now means what no `after`
  already meant: run straight from the start.

Also: a failed turn shows plain words in the panel instead of the raw provider error
(which held the whole request), and an error the dashboard gives no reason for tells the
model what to check instead of "Server Error".

Recorded one real conversation (build, then a change) in fixtures/recorded; a core test
makes its changes against the real rules.

* Tag @Agent in a review comment and get its answer in the thread

Writing @Agent in a comment adds a "Looking at the clip" reply, takes a still of
that moment from the team's toolkit, and asks the agent server as the person who
asked. Convex writes the answer, so everyone in the room sees it arrive.

* Send the still of the moment to the model as the image itself

A toolkit's bucket can be private or on a local network the model provider cannot
reach, so the agent server fetches the still and sends its bytes. Without it, the
agent still answers.

* Answer @Agent with Sonnet 5.5, and connect the agent with one command

- `pnpm setup:agent` makes MASTRA_JWT_SECRET once and sets it, with the agent's address,
  in .env.local, packages/agent/.env and Convex (AGENT_URL), so nobody copies a secret.

  decided; people not asked cannot press Approve or Reject.

title: Test one step on its own from its settings panel
description:
* Test one step on its own from its settings panel

A step's panel gets "Test this step": pick an uploaded file or drop one, and
only that step runs, with its settings as they are in the editor, saved or not.
Settings that point at an earlier step's file take the chosen file instead. The
result shows in the panel and updates live: status, time taken, what the step
found out and the files it made. Tests show in the runs list as "Test of
<step>", and a failed test alerts nobody.

Also names the starting file from its address when a run was started by hand.

* Run a test again as a test of the same step

title: Review agent: key from Infisical, and seeing motion, pacing and sound
description:
* Take the model key from Infisical instead of asking for it

`pnpm setup:agent` no longer tells anyone to paste ANTHROPIC_API_KEY into a file. The
agent server starts through `infisical run`, which hands it the key, and setup sets
CHAT_MODEL to Sonnet 5.5 and leaves the empty key line as a comment so it cannot hide
the key Infisical passes in.

* Let the review agent see motion, pacing and sound

When someone tags @Agent, the room now asks the team's toolkit for more
than one still: a 4x3 sheet of frames around the moment, FFmpeg's cut
detection for pacing, loudness overall and at the moment, quiet gaps,
and a transcript of the 30 seconds around it. The agent gets the frames
as a second image and the measurements in its prompt.

The browser test's toolkit stand-in now runs the Python and FFmpeg
compose jobs for real, and the replayed answer was re-recorded from a
real model run.

* Match the replayed review answer on its question

CI's browser run built a slightly different prompt from the one that was
recorded, so the strict replay had no answer for it. The recording now
matches on Maya's question line; the Convex tests check what is sent.

title: Show what passed between steps, turn a step off, copy and paste steps
description:
* Show what passed between steps on a run

Each line on a run's canvas says how many files went along it ("1 file",
"none" for the way an If did not send anything), and each row in "What
happened" says which files the step got. A logic step's own reading of a file
is no longer shown as facts.

* Turn a step off without removing it

* Test a step even while it is off; show no files as made by an off step

* Copy, paste and duplicate steps on the canvas
